propositions: Network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeouts and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
clone_change_ref subprocess calls do not pass timeout parameter and TimeoutExpired exceptions bypass credential redaction, creating a security disclosure path
workspace._git helper lacks timeout parameter causing all git calls in the module to be unbounded, including two network-capable fetch operations
RefLockTimeoutError sites in _ref_lock.py are already structurally bounded by a required timeout keyword parameter and need no modification
TimeoutExpired exceptions must be converted to domain-specific errors (GerritError, WorkspaceError) that name the operation and bound without exposing credentials
Test coverage must verify timeout presence in all subprocess calls, exception conversion, credential redaction, and that reverting timeouts causes test regression
